title: 一九九八
warn: A haunted night shift: uncanny, then tender, no gore. It ends safe at dawn.
setting: The convenience store, your third night, midnight. The back office is unlocked for the first time.

hongyi.name: 老韩
hongyi.en: the man in the red raincoat

steps.narr: On the counter: the three coins from 1998, back again, in a neat stack.

else.narr: By the door, the red raincoat hangs on a hook. Dry.

steps.narr: Night three. Midnight. You clock on.
Rule three: if the till speaks, answer it.

say.en: Ask the till who it is, and what it wants to say.
say.gloss: Who are you? What do you want to say?
say.tip: 你想说什么？ = what do you want to say?

answers: 你是谁？你到底想跟我说什么？
4.gloss: Who are you? What is it you want to tell me?
4.tip: 到底 dàodǐ = in the end, really: 你到底想说什么？

steps.narr: The back office door is open. On the shelf, under dust: a logbook. On the spine, 1998.
The first page. Read it aloud:

say.gloss: The third of July. Night shift. 老韩.
say.tip: 七月三日 qīyuè sānrì = the third of July: month, then day.

ok.narr: The handwriting. The same as the rules sheet, letter for letter.

2.gloss: 老韩, on the night shift.

answers: 一九九八年七月三日，夜班，老韩。
4.gloss: The third of July, 1998. Night shift. 老韩.

steps.narr: Page after page, in the same hand:

steps.zh: 我写了规则，让下一个人别怕。

steps.narr: The rules didn't keep you safe from him. They kept him out of sight, so nobody new would be frightened.

steps.en: He wants someone to see him.

say.en: Ask the till: what does he want?

fail.en: He wants someone to see him.

answers: 他到底想要什么？我能帮他吗？
4.gloss: What does he really want? Can I help him?

steps.narr: Back at the till. The CCTV screen.
Three people at your counter again: two customers, and you. Rule four: when there are three on the monitor, don't look up.

say.en: Look up and see him, or keep to rule four.
say.gloss: I'm looking up. I want to see him.
say.tip: 抬头 táitóu = raise your head, look up.

ok.narr: You look up. An old man in a red raincoat, the hood down at last.

answers: 我不抬头。规则是为我好。
alts.gloss: I won't look up. The rules are for my sake.

then.narr: You keep your eyes on the till. On the monitor, the man in the raincoat bows slightly, and waits.

answers: 不管规则，我抬头，我要看见他。
4.gloss: Never mind the rules. I'm looking up. I want to see him.

answers: 规则是他写的，为我好，我不抬头。
alts.gloss: He wrote the rules for my sake. I won't look up.

steps.narr: On the monitor, 老韩 waves. He holds up a card:

steps.zh: 我小时候，他给过我一个热包子。
steps.en: When I was little, he gave me a hot 包子.
You walk home in the daylight. For the first time, the shop doesn't frighten you. 🌅

else.en: You walk home in the daylight, the card's three words going round your head. 🌅
